aboutPreview.title: Curious by default.
aboutPreview.body: Computing grad from the University of Melbourne. I like turning small ideas into real, working products — a daily Go puzzle, a map-reading city game, a pixel platformer. AI is both my everyday tool and the thing I keep digging into.

about.title: A little about me
about.intro: Graduated from the University of Melbourne, majoring in Computing and Software Systems. These days I spend my time exploring AI, vibe coding, and the craft of building small, useful software.
